summary: The big mainstream story was Pokémon Center cancelling Delta Reign pre-orders. It targeted bots, but many normal buyers got cancelled too, and they are angry. Trust in graded cards also took a hit: a record $288K PSA 10 Dragonite is facing fake-slab claims, and PSA reopened its Value tier at $39.99 with a 90–100 business day wait. On-chain, rivals pushed pull-clip content hard: Beezie pack battles, Jupiter Gacha memes and a Troll token pack giveaway, and bye.fun live rips with Solana Gaming. Solflare Packs talk was steady and positive, but still mostly small ambassador-style explainer posts.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-10-28 09:07 UTC to 2026-10-29 09:07 UTC, 12 post searches plus 1 X news search. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time; BlackhawkTim's post had 0 likes but is included as a clear pain-point example. The Dragonite forgery item comes from an X news summary (Grok-written), not a confirmed report. Courtyard's $13.8M and the Pump.fun move to Phygitals are third-party claims, not confirmed by the companies. Payments talk was thin: card, Apple Pay and Google Pay searches returned mostly spam and carding posts, so nothing was used. The Troll giveaway is listed as competitor news only. Most Solflare Packs posts come from small ambassador-style accounts with low impressions, so read them as campaign activity, not organic demand. The grading idea is marked for legal check because buyback terms are mentioned. Spam, restock bots, giveaway reply-farms with wallet addresses, token shills and carding posts were skipped. Creators already in collector-base.csv or in earlier daily files were excluded.
